lines.text: Vouvray. Dry one year, sweet the next. Why?
lines.phonemes: vuːvɹˈeɪ. dɹˈaɪ wˈʌn jˈɪɹ, swˈiːt ðə nˈɛkst. wˈaɪ?

lines.text: Since 1936, Chenin Blanc on the north bank of the Loire.
lines.phonemes: sˈɪns nˈaɪntiːnhˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾi sˈɪks, ʃˈɛnɪn blˈɑːŋk ɔnðə nˈɔːɹθ bˈæŋk ʌvðə lwˈɑːɹ.

lines.text: Under the vines lies tuffeau, a soft chalk, full of cellar caves.
lines.phonemes: ˌʌndɚ ðə vˈaɪnz lˈaɪz tuːfˈoʊ, ɐ sˈɔft tʃˈɔːk, fˈʊl ʌv sˈɛlɚ kˈeɪvz.

lines.text: A plateau, 85 to 110 metres high, ends in a cliff over the river.
lines.phonemes: ɐ plætˈoʊ, ˈeɪɾi fˈaɪv tə wˈʌnhˈʌndɹɪd tˈɛn mˈiːɾɚz hˈaɪ, ˈɛndz ɪn ɐ klˈɪf ˌoʊvɚ ðə ɹˈɪvɚ.

lines.text: Tours gets 678 millimetres of rain a year, and the wettest months come after harvest.
lines.phonemes: tˈʊɹ ɡˈɛts sˈɪkshˈʌndɹɪd sˈɛvənti ˈeɪt mˈɪlɪmˌiːɾɚz ʌv ɹˈeɪn ɐ jˈɪɹ, ænd ðə wˈɛɾɪst mˈʌnθs kˈʌm ˈæftɚ hˈɑːɹvɪst.

lines.text: April to October averages 16.2 degrees. Chenin ripens here at its limit.
lines.phonemes: ˈeɪpɹəl tʊ ɑːktˈoʊbɚɹ ˈævɹɪdʒᵻz sˈɪkstiːn pɔɪnt tˈuː dᵻɡɹˈiːz. ʃˈɛnɪn ɹˈaɪpənz hˈɪɹ æɾ ɪts lˈɪmɪt.

lines.text: Vouvray is at least 95 percent Chenin Blanc.
lines.phonemes: vuːvɹˈeɪ ɪz æt lˈiːst nˈaɪnti fˈaɪv pɚsˈɛnt ʃˈɛnɪn blˈɑːŋk.

lines.text: The year decides the style. Sweet wines come in the warmest years.
lines.phonemes: ðə jˈɪɹ dᵻsˈaɪdz ðə stˈaɪl. swˈiːt wˈaɪnz kˈʌm ɪnðə wˈɔːɹmɪst jˈɪɹz.

lines.text: Sparkling Vouvray ages at least 12 months from tirage.
lines.phonemes: spˈɑːɹklɪŋ vuːvɹˈeɪ ˈeɪdʒᵻz æt lˈiːst twˈɛlv mˈʌnθs fɹʌm tiːɹˈɑːʒ.
